posts.title: Scale-Up, Scale-Out, and Scale-Across Networking for GPU Workloads
posts.description: A large AI job isn’t just an application running over the network. Thousands of GPUs could be working together on the same job, repeatedly exchanging data and synchronizing before they can continue. That makes communication performance part of compute performance. posts.title: How AI Factories Change Data Center Networking
posts.description: At first glance, the network inside a modern AI factory can look very similar to a traditional data center network. You’ll see BGP, ECMP, high-radix switches, Clos fabrics, and, in many Ethernet environments, familiar technologies like EVPN-VXLAN. posts.title: Understanding Asymmetric and Symmetric IRB in EVPN-VXLAN Fabrics
posts.description: EVPN-VXLAN can seem unnecessarily complicated until you stop looking at all the individual protocols and start following a packet through the network.
